question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Instead of**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Instead of**" is a preposition that means "in place of; as an alternative to".
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it in
